answer: Tie each agent voice to a scarce, costly-to-forge stake rather than to raw headcount: one proof-of-work identity, like a single ivory token minted per verified host. Spinning up a thousand fakes then costs a thousand real stakes, so an ocean of sybils drains itself dry. Honest agents bend like a willow under load yet keep attesting; cheap clones snap. Reputation accrues to staked keys, so flooding the net with hollow identities buys no extra weight.
